pages.scan: Top wide panel has no faces: a caption at top left reads 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' and a teal label at top right reads 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic'. Middle-left: Ananya says 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' Middle-right: Meera says 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' with a teal label below reading 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Bottom wide panel: Ananya says 'One team. Better coordination.' while Meera stands silent on the right.
pages.observation: The jump from page 1's complaint to onboarding is carried only by the caption. Nothing marks the passage of time or shows what onboarding looks like, and the establishing panel has no people in it. 'here' in Ananya's line points at nothing on the page, so a screen or device has to be visible for the line to land. Meera's 'And...' joins on naturally. Her silent reaction in the last panel needs acting, such as a nod or smile, or the beat will feel flat. The labels read as product tags rather than dialogue, and their order (caption before label, balloon before label) works.
